Copy tuning parameters from an iTRAK mover 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Instruction reads a set of tuning parameters from one mover and applies the parameters to an instance of the raM_iTRAK_Opr_TuneMover instance
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1002 Device Handler faulted 1003 Device Handler is not in state Available 1010 Cfg_MoverID out of bounds. Select a value 0 <= Cfg_MoverID < number of active movers
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 4.0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for iTRAK57xx Device Handler 4.0. Added System Inertia to list of parameters to be copied. 1.1 - Added Notch filter tuning. Event fields match Machine Builder standards order 1.0 - First Release
